plate.narration: A frost wyrm has claimed the new reading room. Its head rests on a bench, and every sleepy breath paints frost ferns on the wall. The yeti builders wait beside their tools. Somehow, everyone needs room.

goal.text: Make room for the readers and the frost wyrm without waking the old ice.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: Beyond the memory reading room, yeti builders have stopped carving a new chamber for the memory readers. A frost wyrm has curled across their doorway, using a bench as a pillow. It opens one eye. "Help us make room for the readers and the wyrm," whispers a builder, "without waking the old ice." Pip stays in the old reading room to help the elder sort the notes.

listen.narration: A chisel scrapes. The wyrm squeezes its bench tight, then loosens when the builder steps back. "That bench has become a very expensive pillow," the builder whispers.

watch_check.narration: Watch the wyrm curl, breathe and rest, then copy it. "This shows its reach today," says a builder. "Not a rule it must obey."

interaction.cue: Watch the nest, then copy the pattern.

onSuccess.narration: You mark the tail's reach and a safe gap.

onFailure.narration: A builder marks a wider gap for you.

onAssisted.narration: A builder marks a wider gap for you.

boundary.narration: Help the builders move everything outside that gap. "Nothing gets taken from under the wyrm," says one. Pick a quiet job. One builder is knitting a hat for a chisel.

supplies.narration: The readers will need furniture. A folded table travels well if the room must move, but is slow to set up here. Shelf parts make a sturdy low shelf here, but only a rough table anywhere else.

table_kit.narration: Level the folded table for carrying. It folds very small. A builder folds the instruction sheet into something much bigger.

interaction.cue: Level the folded table for carrying.

onSuccess.narration: The folding table waits outside the nest.

onFailure.narration: The folding table waits outside the nest.

onAssisted.narration: The folding table waits outside the nest.

shelf_kit.narration: Pass the shelf blocks and the bundled top to the alcove. Every bright mark means builders' wood, not old ice.

interaction.cue: Pass the shelf parts along the safe wall.

onSuccess.narration: The shelf parts wait outside the nest.

onFailure.narration: The shelf parts wait outside the nest.

onAssisted.narration: The shelf parts wait outside the nest.

cold_opening.narration: An opening in the far wall shows a sheltered snow hollow. The Listening Chime can check for a way back. It cannot boss a rift around. Loose bones rattle on this side, and the builders leave them alone. Is the hollow safe?

hollow_view.narration: Wait for the drifting snow to clear. Look for tracks and a way back. That boot-shaped lump is only snow.

interaction.cue: Check the hollow during the clear view.

onFailure.narration: The far edge stays hidden. A builder goes to check.

hollow_help.narration: Hold the marker line while the builder clears the hidden drift and comes back. Everyone stays at the tunnel marker.

interaction.cue: Hold the marker line for the builder.

onSuccess.narration: The hollow is empty and sheltered.

onFailure.narration: The hollow is empty and sheltered.

onAssisted.narration: The hollow is empty and sheltered.

hollow_check.narration: Hold the marker line while a builder steps through to check the ground. Nobody tests strange old ice.

interaction.cue: Hold the marker while the builder checks.

onSuccess.narration: The builder is back. All clear.

onFailure.narration: The builder is back. All clear.

onAssisted.narration: The builder is back. All clear.

hollow_attuned.narration: Your starweaver reads the opening's light while the builders check the empty floor. The way back is clear.

bed.narration: The hollow is safe. A soft snow bed needs its path guarded for one clear round to invite the wyrm. A broad slab needs two, but an unused slab can become a reader step. A builder shrugs. "Neither plan promises the wyrm will cooperate."

bed_snow.narration: Shape loose new snow into a wide, shallow bowl. Keep it level, with a clear way out.

bed_slab.narration: Hold a loose slab while the builder slides it into place. Nobody chips old ice for a pillow.

interaction.cue: Hold the loose slab at the hollow.

lanes.narration: Move the empty benches so the people's way out never crosses the wyrm's path. A builder's lunch bag was being used as a wall. It retires.

interaction.cue: Hold the bench while the way is cleared.

onSuccess.narration: Nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

onFailure.narration: Nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

onAssisted.narration: Nobody stands between the wyrm and shelter.

rest.narration: The builders lead you into a side alcove, away from the nest. They share oat cakes from a scrubbed tool tin. One cake is shaped like a very blunt chisel. A builder beams at it. "My best work."

signal.narration: A builder raises a mitten for wait, opens both palms for clear and lowers them for finish. She wiggles the mitten. "These are for us. They do not control the wyrm."

interaction.cue: Watch the signals, then copy them.

onSuccess.narration: You can show the readers later.

onFailure.narration: A builder will lead the readers by markers.

onAssisted.narration: A builder will lead the readers by markers.

offer.narration: The hollow is ready, and the people wait behind the benches. Drive the creatures from the doorway, or guard the quiet path and invite the wyrm in. Only an invitation makes it a friend. If you lose, the readers simply stay in their old room.

fight.narration: The frost wyrm rises, and the loose bones rattle upright. Drive them from the doorway, or guard the hollow path for 2 clear rounds to invite the wyrm in. The slick new ice slows anyone who stops on it.

fight_soft.narration: The frost wyrm rises, and the loose bones rattle upright. Drive them from the doorway, or guard the hollow path for 1 clear round to invite the wyrm in. The slick new ice slows anyone who stops on it.

room_clear.narration: The doorway is clear, and the builders lower their mittens. The bench has a wyrm-shaped dent. The builders decide it is a special chair.

variants.text: The wyrm settles into the sheltered hollow. When a builder hums, it hums back. You have a new neighbor.
The wyrm backs into the outer tunnel. It has not picked the hollow, but the builders leave it open.

room_moved.narration: The wyrm keeps its doorway, and you pull back behind the benches. The builders help you rest, then unroll the wall plan. "The room can go here," says one, pointing down a clear tunnel. The new reading room will open later, away from the nest.

shelves.narration: Choose furniture for the room you have. Whatever kit you carried can become a working table.

variants.text: The new site needs more carving, and its floor cannot hold shelf blocks yet. For now only the broad table fits in the old room. The builders will finish the new chamber after you leave.

shelf_build.narration: Hold the low top while the builders fix its wide blocks. Nothing gets fixed to the old ice.

unpack_shelf.narration: Pass the shelf pieces into place for a working table. The broad top holds the notes. The blocks stay loose for now.

interaction.cue: Pass our kit pieces for the working table.

onSuccess.narration: The parts are ready to level.

onFailure.narration: The parts are ready to level.

onAssisted.narration: The parts are ready to level.

variants.text: On this bumpy floor, the folding table needs its low stand. Pass the pieces over. The instruction sheet has unfolded into a small tent.

shelves_check.narration: Level the working table on checked floor. A sliding book is becoming a very short story.

onSuccess.narration: The notes have a steady place to work.

onFailure.narration: The notes have a steady place to work.

onAssisted.narration: The notes have a steady place to work.

slab_route.narration: Whatever the wyrm sleeps on stays with the wyrm. Loose new snow stays where you shaped it.

reader_step.narration: Hold the unused slab while the builder carries it to the notes. It is new ice, not a piece of the old wall.

interaction.cue: Hold the slab for the low step.

onSuccess.narration: Now readers can reach their notes.

onFailure.narration: Now readers can reach their notes.

onAssisted.narration: Now readers can reach their notes.

readers.narration: The readers wait with their notes in the old room. Show them the builder signals you remembered, or pass the bundles along builder markers.

variants.text: The readers wait with their notes in the old room. A builder will lead them by markers. Pass the bundles from mitten to mitten.
Today the path stays inside the old room, past the crowded benches.

readers_check.narration: Show the readers the builder signals. You saw wait, clear, wait, finish. Ask for help rather than guess.

interaction.cue: Show the signals to the readers.

onFailure.narration: Switch to the builder markers instead.

onAssisted.narration: Switch to the builder markers instead.

readers_markers.narration: Pass the heavy bundles from builder to builder, each one in sight of the next mitten.

interaction.cue: Pass the bundles along the markers.

onSuccess.narration: The readers and every bundle arrive.

onFailure.narration: The readers and every bundle arrive.

onAssisted.narration: The readers and every bundle arrive.

readers_clear.narration: The readers reach their work place with their notes. One reader pats the stack. "Every page is here."

variants.text: Their work place is a crowded corner of the old room. The new chamber is a job for another day.

quiet.narration: Pick one good rule for readers and builders. Nobody expects a wild wyrm to obey a sign. "The new rule is for us," says a builder, "the people holding the chisels."

ending.narration: The readers have room for their notes. The wyrm has room to rest. The old ice stays quiet. A builder hangs the chisel hats by the door. "No scraping near the neighbor."

variants.text: A soft rumble answers from the hollow. The builders will keep that path open for you.
The new chamber must wait. The builders give up their free morning to finish the move.
The unused resting slab has become a low reader step.
The folding table now holds the readers' notes.
The low shelf stands on checked floor, easy to reach.
Your nest drawing shows the tail pattern you saw.
Your nest drawing notes a builder's help.

boundary_response_pad.narration: The padded chisels make no scrape. Now the builders can start a reading place.

boundary_response_stool.narration: The stool sits past the tail mark. Now the builders can start a reading place.

boundary_response_sign.narration: A builder chalks the edge on new ice only. Now the builders can start a reading place.

quiet_response_tools.narration: The builder puts a hat back on the biggest chisel. The readers can work without anyone poking the old ice.

quiet_response_space.narration: Now readers can see where not to stand. The readers can work without anyone poking the old ice.

quiet_response_notes.narration: The smallest reader carries the last loose page. The readers can work without anyone poking the old ice.
